system.name: SPARKLE / SparkleRL-PSS
system.one_liner: An analysis framework for how RL changes math reasoning, and a two-stage RL recipe that revisits the hardest problems with partial step scaffolding.

content.variant_note: left: the two-stage training recipe; middle: four hint types as numbered cards; right: bar chart of gain with versus without hints
content.argues: Hints can hurt base and SFT models but help RL-tuned ones, and the hardest problems can be reused in Stage 2 RL when given partial step scaffolding.
content.subject: A two-stage RL recipe with robots, four colour-coded hint cards, and a bar chart of performance gain for Base, +SFT and +RL.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a menu of variants as numbered, colour-coded cards that each hold the same tiny scene (question, hint, answer), and tie the colours to the result chart with wedge arrows and legend circles so the finding reads without a table.

summary: SPARKLE is an analysis framework that dissects how RL changes mathematical reasoning, and SparkleRL-PSS is a two-stage RL recipe that revisits the hardest problems with partial step scaffolding. Figure 1 has three parts. Left: a card with a difficulty legend and two stages in which a base-model robot, a pile of coloured question bubbles and RL arrows lead to SparkleRL (Stage 1) and then SparkleRL (Stage 2-pss). Middle: four numbered, colour-coded hint cards (partial step scaffolding, high-level plan, external knowledge, chain of subproblems), the last three boxed as the analysis. Right: a bar chart of performance gain with versus without hints for Base, +SFT and +RL, tied to the cards by coloured wedges.
summary_zh: SPARKLE 是剖析强化学习如何改变数学推理的分析框架，SparkleRL-PSS 是用部分步骤脚手架重训最难题的两阶段方案。图 1 左为两阶段训练配方，中为四类彩色编号提示卡片，右为加提示前后的性能增益柱状图。
notes: The figure is assembled from placed bitmaps (cards, icons, chart) with only 36 live text items; the dashed boxes and soft shadows belong to the bitmaps. Prior labels kept in order (contribution-mosaic as a deliverables triptych, stage-pipeline for the left card, scope-overview for the hint gallery). The meaning of the green versus red A circles in card 1 and of the robot moods is not stated. The stepped dashed box around cards 2 to 4 is read as the SPARKLE framework from the caption.
